scope: Hardware WebGL comparison of framebuffer validation before/after. Not a measurement of the user's complete DJ session or presented FPS.

comparison.input: Synthetic moving/spot/bar sources expanded into the actual room preset; fixed dancer camera. Same targets, colors, power and geometry in both runs.
comparison.timing: CPU submission and total render including gl.finish plus gl.getError, measured in the same browser. Total is the graphics call only; excludes room/geometry preparation and compositor presentation.

snapshot.method: gl.readPixels immediately after the last render in the same task, before requestAnimationFrame; compare all RGBA bytes.

regression: scripts/check-dmx-stage-gpu.mjs: initial/steady/resized/steady framebuffer check counts 2/2/4/4. Browser checks passed for GPU/Canvas images, context loss, fallback and disposal.
